deploy-bot: Scheduled emergency deploy v2.3.7 -> prod (eu-west1) at 2024-06-11T00:15:32Z. Reason: 502 spikes on inference pool. Change window: midnight. Approvals required: eng-lead, oncall, sec. Details: canary rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 2% sustained 5m or latency P95 > 800ms for 5m.
maya: tagging here — need rollback steps and backup pin. Can we pin to v2.3.6 immediately if needed?
liam: rollback plan: pin routing to v2.3.6 via router flag, scale-down new pods, hold traffic. I can run rollback until 00:40 UTC.
rebecca: security check: no key rotation, TLS ok, KMS unchanged. sec +1 :white_check_mark:
sam: ops note: Dedicated customers on eu-west1 might see brief 429s when we shift. We'll pre-warm standby pool.
ops-sre: skipping canary is risky. propose 5% for 10m, monitor, then 25% for 10m. If metrics stable, full.
maya: +1 to staged canary. Also enable verbose tracing for first 15m.
liam: +1. Will add telemetry flag `deploy.trace=on`.
eva: oncall +1. I'll be here 00:10-01:00 UTC to act on rollbacks.
deploy-bot: Awaiting approvals: maya, liam, rebecca, eva. Use `/deploy start v2.3.7 --region eu-west1 --canary 5% --trace on` to begin. Auto-monitor rule: `error_rate>0.02@5m -> trigger rollback`.
maya: Approve :thumbsup:
liam: Approve :thumbsup:
rebecca: Approve :thumbsup:
eva: Approve, watching :eyes:
deploy-bot: Starting canary now. PID 4389. Canary target 5%.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% after 12m, metrics within thresholds.
ops-sre: observed small spike at +8m but recovered, solid now.
liam: rolling to 100% in 3m, prepping pin command.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete. v2.3.7 live in eu-west1. Monitoring: error_rate 0.4% P95 210ms.
maya: Verified smoke tests OK.
rebecca: security scan results: no issues.
eva: oncall confirmed no incidents during window. Closing thread. :rocket:
